verdict.rationale: The docs say you can configure payout frequency for each merchant account and choose when and in which currency to settle, so the schedule-control half of the story is covered. The breakdown half is barely evidenced: the only related item is a reporting page offering a 'visual representation of your balances, sales, and payouts', with nothing showing a per-payout breakdown of charges, fees and refunds. Missing for 10: a documented per-payout settlement or reconciliation report listing the transactions, fees and refunds in each payout, and independent or hands-on corroboration of payout scheduling.
